correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact KL projection for the reflected row weights (z^-1,t,z) imposes mean a through s=z+z^-1 and d=z-z^-1=a(s+t), giving s=(a²t+sqrt(a²t²+4(1-a²)))/(1-a²). Column rescaling returns t+=(1-b)s/b; t0=2(1-b)/b. For b>a, the fixed point t*=2(1-b)/sqrt(b²-a²) satisfies q0=1-b; F is increasing/strictly convex with sharp global sup derivative L=a(1-b)/[b(1-a)]<1 and local rho=a²(1-b)/[b(b-a²)]. Taylor expansion of row KL about q0(t*) yields successive relative-entropy ratio rho². At feasible boundary b=a, the positive recurrence has t_{k+1}-t_k=2(1-a)/(a²t_k)+O(t_k^-3), giving t_k/sqrt(k)→2sqrt(1-a)/a and kq_-(t_k),kH(pi*|pi_k)→a(1-a)/4. KL is measured at the martingale half-steps, not column-restored steps. This is an exact finite-state proof, not a general claim for all martingale Sinkhorn instances.
